opportunities.name: Ryanair flight search (round trip or one-way by airport pair and dates)
opportunities.description: Search Ryanair for flights between an origin and destination airport, with depart/return dates and passenger counts, then pick the outbound and return flights. Parameterised by origin, destination, dates, passengers and optional promo code.
steps: Open ryanair.com and go to the Flights tab.
Choose Return trip or One way.
Click the From field, pick the origin country/airport from the list (or type it).
Click the To field, pick the destination country, then the destination airport.
Click the Depart field and choose the start month in the calendar, then click the depart day.
If return trip, click the Return field and click the return day.
Click the Passengers field, use + / - to set Adults (and Teens/Children/Infants if needed), then click Done.
Optionally click Apply promo code and type the code.
Click Search.
On results, click Select on the outbound flight, then Select on the return flight.

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search by destination and date, then open a ticket listing
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com Attractions for things to do in a city, set a visit date, sort results, open a tour and set ticket counts. Parameterised by destination, date, sort order and tour choice.
steps: Open booking.com and click the Attractions tab (or pick a region/city tile on the Attractions page).
Click the destination search box and type the city or attraction, then pick the suggestion.
Click Select your dates and choose the date in the calendar.
Click Search.
Optionally choose a sort tab (Our top picks, Most popular, Lowest price) and tick filters.
Click the desired activity card or See availability.
Click Show more dates if needed, pick the date, set ticket counts and click Next.

opportunities.name: Resy restaurant search and set a Notify for a fully booked slot
opportunities.description: Search Resy for a restaurant by name or cuisine, open the result, set date and party size, and if no table is open, set a Notify for a meal period with a preferred time window. Parameterised by search term, city, date, party size and meal period.
steps: Open resy.com and, if needed, change the city from the location menu.
Click the restaurant search box and type a restaurant name or cuisine.
Click the matching restaurant in the dropdown.
Set the date and Guests on the restaurant page.
If no slots are open, click Notify for Lunch or Dinner.
Pick the preferred start and end time in the dialog and click Confirm.
